save_agent_metadata: save agent metadata by dispatching to tips, feedback, worker opinion, or default handlers
save_worker_opinion: save worker opinion data with attachments and toxicity-scored question answers to agent state
save_feedback: save feedback submissions with optional Detoxify toxicity scoring to the agent state metadata
save_tips: save a tip with header and text to the agent state metadata tips list
save_metadata_without_transforming: save raw metadata data directly to the agent state without any transformation
